question: Which of the following national parks is situated in Kerala?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Eravikulam National Park.** __

__
 
• There are six national parks in Kerala:
 
 
• **Eravikulam National Park**,
 
• Silent Valley National Park,
 
• Periyar National Park,
 
• Pampadum Shola National Park,
 
• Anamudi Shola National Park and
 
• Mathikettan Shola National Park (Idukki National Park).
 
 

**Trick to remember - **__Ravi Pyar Me Silent Shola Ho Gaya

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Sanjay Gandhi National Park** is in Mumbai, Maharashtra.
 
• **Kaziranga National Park** is in Assam.
 
• **Tadoba Andhari Tiger Reserve** is a wildlife sanctuary in the Chandrapur district of Maharashtra.
